reuse.why: Adds the rule to the existing getMonthWideTargetCategories selection and parses notes with the existing shared extractTagsFromText, so tag escaping matches the rest of the app.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the single selection function gains one condition.

placement.why: The rule lands in the one function that defines which categories month-wide actions write, in budget/actions.ts.

scope.why: Only the selection function, its comment and the tests for all month-wide actions change.

maintainability.why: Clear and centralised; the rule is now split between SQL filters and a post-query JS filter in the same function, and the 'fixed' tag is an inline literal.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions (copy, zero, averages, last-month spending) already go through getMonthWideTargetCategories, which the change extends.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the tag parsing is delegated to extractTagsFromText.

one_place.where: getMonthWideTargetCategories in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts, used by copyPreviousMonth, setZero, setMonthWideAverage and setLastMonthSpending.
